## Kit plugin: design
Website and UI work: creative process, reference boards, era floor standards, components, motion and visual QA.

### Skills
| Skill | Use when | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| `website-builder` | the user wants a website, landing page, redesign or any human-facing UI, including when a brand, PRD or reference is already supplied. | small tweaks to an already approved design, or backend-only work. |
| `ui-standards` | building or reviewing ANY frontend: pages, sections, components, dashboards or mobile views. | picking a creative direction from scratch (website-builder first) or animation-only work (use animate). |
| `ui-mate` | the user references a component number like #0003 or 'no 3', or before hand-writing a common interactive component ui-mate may already have. | non-React projects, or when the user wants a component written from scratch. |
| `frontend-design` | writing the actual markup and styles for a page or section once direction is set, as a companion to ui-standards. | installing or theming ui-mate components, or choosing the concept (website-builder owns that). |
| `emil-design-eng` | polishing a component or interaction, deciding whether and how something should move, or making UI feel great rather than merely correct. | layout or concept decisions, or naming an effect (use animation-vocabulary). |
| `apple-design` | gesture-driven UI, springs, drag, swipe or sheet interactions, momentum, interruptible transitions or translucent depth. | scroll-driven storytelling sections (use animate) or static layouts. |
| `animation-vocabulary` | the user describes an effect without knowing its name ('the bouncy thing when it opens') or a reference board needs precise motion terms. | implementing the animation (use animate). |
| `animate` | asked to animate something, add motion, a scroll effect, a hover, a transition or a micro-interaction. | auditing existing motion (use review-animations) or spotting where motion is missing (use find-animation-opportunities). |
| `find-animation-opportunities` | the user asks what could be animated or wants a page to 'feel more alive'. | fixing or reviewing motion that already exists (use review-animations). |
| `review-animations` | reviewing or improving existing animations, or as the motion pass of visual QA before a UI ships. | code correctness review (use audit) or adding new motion (use animate). |
| `prototype` | the user explicitly asks for prototypes, variants or 'show me options' for a section or component. | anything without the explicit ask. It does not trigger on its own. |

### MCP servers
| Server | Use when | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| `playwright` | visual QA of a running page (390, 768 and 1440 widths), checking animations render, reading console errors, or screenshotting real reference sites for a board. | unit tests or backend logic, or before anything is running to look at. |

### Subagents (delegate with the Task tool; they start with a fresh context)
| Agent | Use when | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| `visual-qa` | a page or section is built and running and needs QA before it is called done, or the user says it looks off. | before anything renders, or backend-only work. |

### Companion plugins (use their skills when enabled)
| Plugin | Use when | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| `taste-skill` | choosing ONE deliberate visual direction, generating concept comps or a brand kit, converting an image to code, or a redesign pass. | blending several directions on one page, or as evidence on a reference board (generated comps are concepts, not proof). |
| `impeccable` | the critique pass after a UI build, before calling any page done, or when the user says it looks generic. | early concept work before anything is built. Opt-in per project, not in any default profile; offered only when the user asks for design critique. |
